en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky shoreline with calm water in the foreground. On the right is a steep rock face; to the left are simple wooden bathing or changing structures built on the rocks along the water's edge. A forested hillside rises behind the buildings. In the lower left corner there is printed text identifying the location, and in the lower right corner a small triangular printer's logo.
